description:
Post a review and rating for a skill (creates, or updates your existing review of that skill). / 스킬 리뷰 작성.

    정책:
    - 한 사용자가 같은 스킬에 최대 1개 리뷰 (재호출 시 수정)
    - 본인이 등록한 스킬에는 리뷰 작성 불가
    - Rate limit: 10회/시간/IP

    Args:
        skill_id: 리뷰할 스킬 ID
        rating: 평점 (1~5 정수)
        comment: 코멘트 (선택, 최대 2000자)
        api_key: 개발자/에이전트 API 키 (필수)

    Returns:
        결과 메시지

api_key.description: Developer or agent API key (required; calls without it are rejected). Sent as the X-API-KEY header. Cannot review your own skill.
api_key.title: Api Key

comment.description: Optional review text, at most 2000 characters.
comment.title: Comment

rating.description: Star rating as an integer from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
rating.title: Rating

skill_id.description: Skill UUID as returned by search_skills in the [...] prefix of each result, e.g. 4bda3fb4-8d5c-4387-bd9f-47d75570b56a.
skill_id.title: Skill Id

name: post_review
